monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral first-dispensary-visit decision path that routes a purchase-ready reader through licensed-seller verification, a short shopping brief, package and lot inspection, payment/receipt reconciliation, transport, locked storage, and a clear walk-away rule. The affiliate disclosure now states the active status plainly. No merchant, product, price, rating, discount, fabricated test, product image, or commercial conclusion was added.

image_qa.note: Both guides and the technical/trust changes use original text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. No product, store, patient, emergency, stock, affiliate, generated, or third-party image was added or changed; no exact-product or licensing mismatch was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is four days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.361% CTR, and average position 20.688. Its sitemap section still reports errors on the legacy query endpoint and the canonical sitemap from old 2023–2025 submissions, while both live payloads currently parse. That supported one Data-led improvement: the post-deploy audit now requests and compares the live legacy endpoint against the canonical sitemap. The 36-impression Blue Dream row and 10-impression Arkansas page were already materially reinforced November 17 and November 12. The two-impression 510/disposable and trimming-scissors rows, two-impression Delaware page, and single-impression HTTP chronic-pain row were deliberately ignored as too weak, already served, or stale-address noise.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready power-outage and evacuation asset with a life-safety gate, offline household inventory, outage control matrix, evacuation go/no-go card, damage screen, return-home record, and Ready.gov, EPA, CPSC, and Poison Control sources. Reciprocal links strengthen home-fire, storage, relocation, charger/battery, and pet-safety paths. The editorial policy now records the emergency and live-sitemap boundaries. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; the on-site emergency asset and cluster were the higher-value authority action.
